---
title: Add API endpoints to create/update/delete activities
labels:
  - enhancement
---

## Summary

Extend the backend API so activities can be managed programmatically instead of only supporting signup/unregister.

## Requirements

- Add endpoints for creating a new activity.
- Add endpoints for updating an activity's details.
- Add endpoints for deleting an activity.
- Ensure the UI can call these endpoints from the admin dashboard.

## Notes

This will make the system more flexible and support admin functionality found in the ActivityHub comparison.
